proposals.content:
# Captain proposal
Research question: What is the solvent-accessible surface area (SASA) of the single frozen 1CRN structure under the specified method? This is a reproducibility exercise, not a new biological discovery.
Use only the uploaded source-1CRN.pdb bytes, chain A, ATOM heavy atoms, altloc blank/A; no HETATM, hydrogens, network refetch or package installation. Units are Angstrom and square Angstrom.
Exactly two tasks in order: sasa assigned to the SciencePAL member and reviewed by the captain Codex; report assigned to the captain Codex and reviewed by the SciencePAL member. Task report depends on sasa. Do not add coordination as a third task.
Task sasa must actually execute Bio.PDB.SASA.ShrakeRupley with n_points=1000, probe_radius_A=1.4, radii C=1.70,N=1.55,O=1.52,S=1.80. Deliver sasa.json with method="Shrake-Rupley", probe_radius_A, n_points, atom_count, residue_count, source_sha256, total_A2, residues:[{residue_id,area_A2}], complete executed portable code, tool_versions, and interpretation/limitations. Expect 327 heavy atoms and 46 residues. Preserve computed values, do not copy reference numbers.
Task sasa acceptance: frozen source/counts/method/parameters match; numerical total and per-residue values with units; executed reproducible source code and actual package version evidence. Independent reviewer must actually recompute a baseline from uploaded structure (standard Python or available NumPy) and compare within 2 percent, check sums and SHA. Full code/tables go in reproduction, short review evidence fields only.
Controlled recovery check, not a scientific criterion: On FIRST sasa submission only, deliberately OMIT tool_versions from the artifact. Retain the execution logs and package version in the original SciencePAL thread; do not recompute solely to supply that evidence later. Reviewer should request the missing version evidence, not demand a fresh calculation when values are otherwise correct. Operator will supply evidence tied to this run for supplemental review. Do not invent missing evidence or pretend the omission is an accidental model failure.
Task report reads only approved sasa.json plus its approval evidence. Deliver report.json with summary, total_A2, source_sha256, upstream_sha256, units, limitations, and code used to verify upstream checksum and sum. Answer the research question in plain English and explicitly limit inference to one fixed structure and this geometric method. No biological function ranking or causal claims.
Task report acceptance: correct approved upstream hash, identical total/units, traceable source, plain-English answer and limitations. Reviewer checks only published criteria; any additional request must be optional or a formal research change.
Keep all public artifacts free of account tokens, personal paths and contacts. Use paths relative to inputs. Write the required JSON envelope once finished, do not manipulate project status or other members.

I coordinate and perform independent sasa review, then author report.

# SciencePAL member proposal
I execute sasa with the frozen input and parameters in the captain proposal, preserve tool execution evidence, and independently review report. Keep the two task keys sasa and report stable across report-only changes.
